tags.description: Kami Unawatuna is a calm and cozy villa tucked slightly away from the busy beachside, offering a peaceful retreat surrounded by tropical greenery. It’s a place where you can unwind, enjoy quiet mornings, and feel the slow, relaxed rhythm of Unawatuna.
